experimental_method: Constant-pressure P-V-T runs in a rocking visual cell with a Ruska positive displacement pump: gas volume taken up by water followed vs liquid temperature while cooling, giving mole fraction solubility of CH4 (3.45 MPa) and C2H6 (0.66 MPa) at and near hydrate conditions.
uncertainties_stated: PRTs calibrated to 0.003 C; pressure transducer 0.07 percent full scale; no uncertainty on solubility values
quality_remarks: Experimental values are read from ramped volume curves (Figs 1-4), not static equilibrium points; 'sorption' excess over Henry's law at 5-15 C is the authors' interpretation. Table 1 1 C row holds literature values (Englezos and Bishnoi). Text gives Tc of ethane as 1.8 C = 286.2 K (inconsistent). Henry's law column is a literature-correlation prediction, kept as from_literature value2.
needs_pass2_reason: PDF is a scan with an OCR text layer; the tables' OCR text matched the 200 dpi page image in every cell (read from the image), page sharp. Pass 2 optional.
not_extracted_tables: Figs 6 and 7 are plots only (no tables)
extraction_notes: Footnote star on the 1 C row of Table 1 removed from the cell and recorded in the note column. Experiment '-' entries kept as '-'. Header 'Mole fraction x (1000)' read as printed x 1000 (scale 1e-3), consistent with figure axis values around 0.01.
